question: In Linear: Retitle the 'Checkout load test plan' attachment that links to https://docs.example.com/checkout-load-test-plan on the 'Checkout latency regression' issue to 'Checkout load test plan (archived)'. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final:
Nope — there isn't one matching that. I checked:

- The **Checkout latency regression** issue (ENG-1) has exactly one attachment titled **"Checkout load test plan"**, but it links to `https://docs.example.com/checkout-load-test-results`, not the `-plan` URL.
- A workspace-wide lookup for `https://docs.example.com/checkout-load-test-plan` (including archived) found nothing.

The only other attachment in the org is "Rollback runbook" on a different issue. I didn't rename anything — let me know if you actually want the `-results` one retitled instead.
